info.title: LMS Certificate Service
info.description: Certificate templates, issue on course pass, PDF, public verification and revocation for the LMS platform.

post.description: `course_id` empty makes the platform default. `body_text` / `footer_text` may use `{student_name} {course_title} {completion_date} {institution_name} {score_percent} {grade} {issuer} {certificate_id}`; `grade_bands` map a score to a label (the lowest band must start at 0).
